product_launches.description: Cartography Biosciences has advanced its lead investigational therapy CBI-1214, a T-cell engager targeting LY6G6D, into a Phase 1 clinical trial for MSS/MSI-L colorectal cancer, marking its transition to a clinical-stage company.

overview_description.description: Cartography is an oncology company that develops cancer immunotherapies that target novel and highly specific tumor antigens. The company provides a differentiated oncology pipeline of antibody-based therapies to target tumors more precisely than existing therapeutics. Its ATLAS and SUMMIT drug discovery platforms are powered by an industry-leading, fully integrated dataset spanning hundreds of thousands of cell states across the healthy body and large-scale profiling of individual cells from patient tumors.

product.name: ATLAS Platform
product.description: A computational and biological platform that maps antigen expression across tumor and healthy cells to identify tumor-selective targets for antibody-based cancer therapies.

product.name: CBI-1214
product.description: A tumor-selective T-cell engager in clinical development for colorectal cancer, designed to direct T cells toward cells expressing a specific tumor antigen.

product.name: CB02
product.description: A preclinical T-cell engager program for solid tumors, selected through Cartography’s antigen-targeting platform.

product.name: CB34 x CB48
product.description: A preclinical paired-target antibody program for solid tumors that uses two targets to improve tumor-cell selectivity.
